identifier.value: Aries IBFD Lumbar Interbody Fusion Devices

product.name: Aries IBFD Lumbar Interbody Fusion Devices
product.description: Lumbar interbody fusion implants with a multi-axis mesh and micro-surface topography designed to facilitate bone fusion and provide radiovisibility.

product.name: Black Diamond POCT Screw System
product.description: A posterior occipito-cervico-thoracic screw system for precise screw placement and rod insertion, enabling fixation from the occiput to the sacrum.

product.name: Black Diamond Pedicle Screw System (PSS)
product.description: A thoracolumbar fixation system suitable for minimally invasive and open procedures, offering versatile screw options and intuitive instrumentation.

product.name: Blue Topaz Sacroiliac Screw System
product.description: Fenestrated, double helix threaded sacroiliac screws with surface treatment to promote bone growth and optional lag caps for joint compression.

product.name: Gemini-C Cervical Interbody Device (CID)
product.description: A cervical interbody implant combining porous titanium and radiolucent PEEK to support bone growth, visualization, and subsidence reduction.

product.name: Pisces-SA Standalone ALIF Platform
product.description: A standalone anterior lumbar interbody fusion device with a porous 3D printed interbody, anchor fixation, and guided locking plate for minimally invasive surgery.
